report:
### 1. Sample adequacy
20 fields examined, 20 white cells counted — fewer than 100, so differential is only indicative. All fields contained white cells. Red cells 193 (~9.7 per field, count is indicative) and platelets 13 (~0.7 per field).

### 2. Differential (20 white cells)
Neutrophils 40% (8), lymphocytes 20% (4), monocytes 10% (2), eosinophils 5% (1). Outside indicative adult ranges: basophils 5% (1, range 0-2%), immature granulocytes 15% (3, range 0-1%), erythroblasts 5% (1, range 0%).

### 3. Review list
Analyzer marked 2 cells for review; 5 cells flagged for priority review:
- High priority — rare types: IG cells 8, 12, 9 and erythroblast cell 20. Second opinions disagreed on the 3 IGs — reason for human check, not a correction.
- High priority — uncertain detection: cell 8 (IG) and cell 2 (basophil) were kept only because the field had no sure white cell and may not be white cells at all.

### 4. Limits
Second-opinion model is generalist (65% on single cells, weak on IG/erythroblasts) vs classifier 97.6%; red cells undercounted on crowded fields; reference ranges are indicative adult ranges — lab ranges prevail.

known_limits: The second opinion model is a generalist: 65 % right on single PBC cells, weak on ig and erythroblasts (experiment 01). The classifier is 97.6 % right on the same data (experiment 05).
Red cells are undercounted on crowded fields (experiment 14); the red cell count is indicative.
Reference ranges are indicative adult ranges; the lab's own ranges prevail.

second_opinions.reasoning:
Small round mononuclear cell with high N:C ratio, condensed chromatin and a thin rim of basophilic cytoplasm without granules or lobation is typical for a lymphocyte.
LABEL: lymphocyte

Large cell with eccentric dense round nucleus and intensely basophilic agranular cytoplasm without segmentation favors a nucleated erythroid precursor over a lymphocyte.
LABEL: erythroblast

Round densely condensed pyknotic nucleus with homogeneous dark chromatin and a moderately abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm without specific granules or lymphoid clumping favors a nucleated erythroid cell over a mature leukocyte.
LABEL: erythroblast

Round dense pyknotic nucleus with coarse chromatin and basophilic agranular cytoplasm without WBC granulation/lobation indicates a nucleated red cell precursor.
LABEL: erythroblast
